content.comment_body: Hello, I recently uninstalled my [product_name] software and no longer have access to a CD/DVD drive. Is it possible to install the software from an online download? I am able to run the demo version, but I need the fully licensed version. Any assistance would be appreciated!

Without the original CD/DVD for [product_name], it's not possible to install an upgrade or update, as the physical media acts as the license. If you still have the original CD/DVD, you can create an image copy and transfer it to a USB stick.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have difficulty reinstalling [product_name] after losing access to their CD drive and installation media. The demo version is available online, but the licensed full version requires the original CD/DVD for installation, which acts as the license. This process lacks flexibility for digital distribution, making recovery challenging when hardware is limited.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to be able to digitally download and reinstall the full licensed version of [product_name] without needing a CD/DVD drive.
